objective: Close the physical-interface fairness gap between the M342 shared K8 service and the M349 K1x8 baseline by converting one tagged multi-bank transaction into eight independent SRAM-bank handshakes and reconstructing one atomic response.

innovation_boundary.request_mechanism: one-entry fall-through per-bank distributor that records only unaccepted banks
innovation_boundary.response_mechanism: eight slot-indexed assemblies keyed by epoch, slot, generation and tag
innovation_boundary.backpressure_mechanism: held completed-slot selection preserves the visible response under core stall
innovation_boundary.paper_role: canonical external bank adapter for matched K8 versus K1x8 area, timing and energy comparisons

development_correction.initial_issue: a newly completed lower-numbered slot could replace a stalled visible response
development_correction.repair: latch the selected completed slot on the first stalled response cycle

next_gate: Integrate M342 SOURCE_CAP=8 behind this adapter, expose the same eight scalar bank endpoints as M349, and rerun equal-bandwidth frozen FC2 replay before matched DC.
